name: CineStream
description: One stop solution for Movies, Series, Anime, AsianDrama and Torrents (includes CineAnime: AniList + TMDB + AnimePahe). v555: fixes TV saving an invalid Cloudflare cookie. (1) The visible dialog snapshots any cf_clearance that existed BEFORE the asynchronous cookie purge, falling back to the cookie persisted in Settings when a cold-start TV WebView has not loaded its cookie store yet. Previously initialClearance was never set in visible mode, so the first 2s poll accepted a stale token as fresh, closed the dialog, and saved an invalid cookie. (2) The headless solver snapshots the same pre-purge token. (3) isCloudflarePage no longer treats a bare HTTP 403/503 as a Cloudflare challenge — kwik.cx returns 403 for expired/hotlink-blocked embeds, which popped a pointless kwik bypass during playback. Real challenges still match on the interstitial body or cf-mitigated header. (4) All v553 fixes retained: visible sheet starts expanded, storedActivity cache, bypass always opens when no cookie exists, deferred always completed, stale fragment cleanup, one-solve-at-a-time, per-host cookies, client hints, empty-UA guard, D-pad cursor bounds, TV invisible→visible fallback.
